- Single shareholder holds 63.91%

**Overview:**  
Teguh Bestari Medical Sdn. Bhd. operates a dental clinic and provides orthodontic services in Sabah. The private limited company was incorporated on 17 Oct 1988 and has a share capital of RM100,000. Ownership is concentrated, with a single shareholder holding 63.91% of the equity and two directors on record. Recent financial snapshots show revenues of RM1,071,745; RM1,090,307; and RM1,160,005, with equity rising from RM488,099 to RM614,048. No net‑profit, audit opinion, or current‑ratio data are provided.
